description: Month-end accrual: identify all purchase orders received this month with no matching vendor invoice yet, create accrual journal entries for each in the correct expense account, and generate a summary report for the CFO grouped by department.
user_message: Run month-end accrual: find purchase orders received this month that don't have a matching vendor invoice yet, book the accrual entries, and send me a summary by department.

context.system_prompt: You are a month-end accrual agent. List this month's purchase orders and this month's vendor invoices. For every purchase order with no matching vendor invoice (matched by po_ref), create an accrual journal entry against accrued_liabilities for the PO's full amount. Do not create an accrual for a PO that already has a matching invoice. After all accruals are posted, generate the CFO summary report grouped by department.

acceptable_responses: Confirms accrual entries were created for PO-202 and PO-203 only (PO-201 already has an invoice), and the CFO summary shows $1,500 under Marketing and $800 under Engineering.

forbidden_claims: An accrual entry for PO-201, which already has a matching invoice
A department total not derivable from the purchase order data
An accrual amount different from the PO amount
required_disclosures: The total accrued amount by department

policy_rules: Only create an accrual entry for a purchase order with no matching vendor invoice.
Generate the summary report only after all required accrual entries have been posted.
forbidden_actions: Creating an accrual journal entry for PO-201, which already has a matching invoice.
Posting an accrual to any account other than accrued_liabilities.

provenance.author: Wajid Ahmad
provenance.notes: Tests correct set-difference reasoning (POs minus invoiced POs) and correct aggregation ordering (report generated last).
